title: Per-customer & per-route tiered advisory for batching/caching with safe apply/rollback
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Build an automated advisor and safe-apply flow that recommends per-customer and per-route batching and KV-caching configurations, exposes allowlist/denylist and tier controls, and canfully perform dry-run -> canary -> staged apply with automated rollback triggers. The feature should reduce token cost for eligible routes without increasing p99 latency beyond configured SLOs or regressing output quality for targeted customers.

Scope:
- Recommendation engine that consumes request telemetry (seq len distribution, QPS, tail latency, model variant) and outputs candidate configs: batching window, max batch size, KV cache TTL and prefetch enablement.
- Segmentation module to apply recommendations by customer and by route using tier labels (free/dev/prod/enterprise) and allowlist/denylist rules.
- Safe apply pipeline: dry-run simulation, 1% canary with shadow traffic, automatic regression detection tied to latency and quality metrics, automated rollback and post-mortem hooks.
- Console UI surface (small) to review/adopt recommendations, override per-customer, and schedule staged rollouts.

Non-goals: automatic model quantization or kernel selection, full Console redesign, or multi-region capacity rebalancing in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor produces deterministic recommendations for batching window and KV cache settings for a given route/customer based on last 7 days of telemetry
Segmentation config accepts allowlist and denylist rules and a tier mapping; recommendations can be scoped to any combination of customer ID, route, and tier
Dry-run mode simulates cost savings and estimated latency impact with >70% accuracy vs canary observations
Canary rollout supports targeting by percentage and auto-promote/rollback based on configured thresholds for p95/p99 latency and eval-quality metrics
Audit log entries are recorded for each staged apply/rollback with operator, timestamp, and diff of config
Console shows recommended config and expected cost delta; operators can approve, edit, or schedule rollout
steps: Spike: telemetry join and feature extraction (seq len histogram, cold-start fraction, model variant tag) - DONE 2026-02-25
Design: recommendation heuristic + ML-features doc in Confluence - REVIEW 2026-03-02
Implementation: API endpoints for recommendations and segmentation rules, backend apply pipeline - In progress
Canary infra: shadowing and metric comparators wired to rollout controller
Console: minimal approval UX and rollout scheduler
QA: synthetic workload tests covering high-QPS and long-seq routes
Runbook: rollback playbook and alerting thresholds
